_note: Taiwan — Round 7 — browser/curl unblock of the access-blocked backlog, 2026-08-29. Every edge here closes a lead that an earlier round recorded as unreachable. The blocks were largely artefacts of the fetch tool, not the sites: mnd.gov.tw is fully readable to plain curl (its 'ROBOTS_DISALLOWED' verdict was WebFetch obeying robots.txt); gob.mx serves its /cms/uploads/attachment/file/ PDFs to curl while Akamai-challenging its HTML; BPS Indonesia's signed web-api.bps.go.id download host is not Cloudflare-walled even though every *.bps.go.id page is. Every quote below was verified verbatim against the fetched bytes (pdftotext/substring match), not against a search snippet or a fetch-tool summary. See project memory unlinked_nodes_wiring_round7_2026-08-29 for the full narrative.

dependencies.basis: The 2025 (114年) National Defense Report's own source note, under its defence-budget-to-GDP comparison, states that the MND budget figure the report publishes is computed from the enacted (法定) FY2024 defence budget at a stated exchange rate. Verbatim (English edition): "The MND budget is calculated based on the legal budget in 2024 at an NTD to USD exchange rate of 30.651:1." The Chinese edition carries the same note: 「國防部預算」係以113年法定預算為列計基礎，按美元計畫匯率 30.651：1 換算。 This resolves the direction of the previously-deferred candidate, which ran the other way: nothing on the budget-document side says budget compilation draws on the National Defense Report.

The same source note in the 2025 National Defense Report states that the ROC GDP figure used throughout its defence-budget-to-GDP analysis is taken from DGBAS's published data, dated to a specific DGBAS release. Verbatim (English edition): "The GDP of the ROC is based on the data announced by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan on August 15, 2025." Chinese edition: 中華民國「GDP」係參考行政院主計總處114年8月15日公布之數據。

The 2025 National Defense Report states that the MND personnel-maintenance budget line (NT$186.9 billion for FY2025) is computed on the basis of budgeted authorised strength (預算員額), taking recruitment, retention results and recent actual payroll headcount as inputs. Verbatim (English edition): "The personnel budget is NT$186.9 billion, which is mainly calculated based on manpower and takes into account personnel recruitment, retention results, actual payroll numbers in recent years, and is reviewed on a rolling basis." Chinese edition: 人員維持 1,869 億元，主要以預算員額為核算基礎，並參考近年人員招募、留營成效、實際發薪人數等因素，滾動檢討。

The 2025 National Defense Report states that the FY2025 uplift to the service members' meal-expense budget line was set by reference to the food-class consumer price index published by DGBAS — a named CPI component series used as a direct input to a defence budget figure. Verbatim (English edition): "Due to inflation, after referencing the consumer price index for food announced by the Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics, Executive Yuan, the budget for meal expenses of service members was increased from NT$2,969-NT$4,779 to NT$3,487-NT$5,947 in 2025." Chinese edition names the series precisely as 食物類消費者物價指數, which is why the target is the CPI component series rather than the headline CPI publication.

The 2025 National Defense Report states that the All-out Defense Mobilization Integrated Information System — run by MND's All-Out Defense Mobilization Agency, secretariat of the Whole-of-Society Defense Resilience Committee — integrates strategic-supply and materials-facility information supplied across ministries and local governments into a single mobilisation resource platform. Verbatim (English edition): "The All-out Defense Mobilization Integrated Information System integrates information on civilian defense resources, supplies and facilities, strategic supplies and air defense shelters, shelters, first aid stations, and non-gratuitous rationing stations, linking central and local government mobilization information and resources."

_dropped.why: RESOLVED (as part_of, not an edge). The previously-deferred candidate edge is a containment relation and must not be minted (a dependency edge between a node and its container is a validator error). Evidenced twice and independently. (1) The 2025 National Defense Report, https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54548: "The defense budget includes the MND's budget, special budget, and fund budget, and has grown from NT$448.3 billion to NT$644.9 billion in the past 5 years (from 2021 to 2025, including the additional budgets), showing a steady upward trend." (2) MND's own budget-policy page https://www.mnd.gov.tw/publication/85285 (published 114.11.03, excerpted from MND's Legislative Yuan business report), which enumerates the asymmetric/resilience instruments inside the FY2026 total: 115年度國防預算按北約標準達9,495億元(含退除役官兵退休給付及海巡支出)，占GDP比率3.32％；其中國防部規劃編列8,060億元…包括年度預算5,614億元…、基金預算654億元、新式戰機與海空戰力提升特別預算692億元，以及「因應國際情勢強化經濟社會及民生國安韌性」與「強化防衛韌性及不對稱戰力」規劃編列之特別預算。 This entry stays reason 'note' rather than 'resolved' because a part_of resolution has no matching live edge by design, and the validator errors on a 'resolved' note that names no live edge. part_of is NOT set on the node in this round — see the open question in HANDOFF.

Considered and declined. The 2025 National Defense Report does state the headline domestic-defence-industry ratio as arithmetic on budget lines — "The foreign acquisition (including acquisitions from U.S. Foreign Military Sales) budget is NT$68.4 billion and the domestic acquisition (manufacturing) budget is NT$70.1 billion, in which self-reliant national defense accounts for 50.61%" (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54548) — but that calculation is performed inside the National Defense Report itself, not published by any standalone MND defence-industry series. MND's actual defence-industry statistics tables (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/informationservices/publication/86508, files 57516-57519) name only internal Armaments Bureau records as their source (資料來源：軍備局(工程營產處)). Attributing the ratio to tw-defense-industry-stats would splice two documents' separate claims into one neither makes.

DECISION (Thomas, 2026-08-30): declined -- scope mismatch, not an authenticity problem. The NDR cites SIPRI's Arms Transfers Database for PRC arms EXPORTS; this node is scoped to Taiwan arms IMPORTS. Do not re-raise. Original entry follows.

Genuine judgment call, deliberately not minted — a node-scope question for Thomas, not an evidence gap. The National Defense Report carries a verbatim source line under its PRC arms-export chart. The English edition renders it "Source: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database" (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54548) but the Chinese original reads 資料來源：SIPRI武器轉讓數據庫 (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/54313) — the Arms Transfers Database, literally the database this node names. The mismatch is scope, not authenticity: the NDR cites it for PRC arms EXPORTS, whereas tw-sipri-arms-transfers is scoped to SIPRI arms-transfer statistics for Taiwan (IMPORTS). Read as the database, this is a clean 'cites'; read as the Taiwan-imports slice, the quote does not say what the edge would claim.

RESOLVED 2026-08-30: minted tw-central-government-budget (中央政府總預算) and wired tw-defense-budget -> tw-central-government-budget (uses_data_from), in tw-central-government-budget-2026-08-30.json. Original entry follows. Fully evidenced edge with no target node in the corpus. MND statistics table 11, 近十年國防部年度預算占中央政府總預算比率統計 (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/57520, 主計局), carries an explicit compilation note naming its statistical universe: 一、統計範圍及對象：中央政府總預算及國防部主管單位預算資料為統計對象。 and 1.中央政府總預算金額指中央政府總預算歲出預算數。 That is a textbook uses_data_from running from tw-defense-budget to the Central Government General Budget (中央政府總預算), but the corpus has no node for it (tw-local-government-finance is sub-national; tw-dgbas is the institution, not the budget). Mint a central-government-budget node and this edge lands immediately, verbatim-quotable.

The special budgets' own compilation basis could not be read, on two distinct and unrelated failures. (1) Every DGBAS special-budget document (總說明, 歲出計畫提要及概況表) for 115年度中央政府保衛國家安全及強化不對稱戰力計畫採購 lives under https://ws.dgbas.gov.tw/001/Upload/461/relfile/ , which fails TLS with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' — tried the proxy CA bundle, the system bundle, --capath /etc/ssl/certs, a concatenated bundle, and the same fetch from the user's device; all identical, and verification was not disabled. (2) MND's own 115年第一季 resilience special-budget progress report (https://www.mnd.gov.tw/File/57257, 1.58 MB) downloads fine but is a scanned image PDF — pdftotext yields zero characters. So it remains untested whether the special budget's 總說明 cites the National Defense Report or the QDR.
